name: @local/dsh-boost-channel
description: Return channel of Boost mode: an append-only, per-tree JSONL store of STRUCTURED envelopes (never the payload), five declared kinds against four runtime-derived states, a wake policy in which a question whose derived state is running does not wake anyone, a delivery budget that bounds the NUMBER of deliveries per sender and per tree while never refusing storage, a per-tree injection policy owned by the RECIPIENT (channel_subscribe / injectKinds) that can never filter a waking kind, and the health counters defined before the first line.
